known_limitations: Publication counts are derived from observations. LFS employment and SOF distribution are only shown at major-group level. No detailed employment is inferred.
The pinned official 2022 workbook contains 466 unit groups; the PSA technical-notes webpage states 456. Workbook codes retained verbatim. The publisher has not clarified this discrepancy.
SOF is the distribution of the survey's OFWs across occupations, not the probability that a domestic worker is an OFW. Missing cells remain missing; shares are not renormalised.

OWS wage references retain the publisher's job-position by industry slices. They include regular cash allowances and cover full-time time-rated workers in formal establishments with 10 or more workers, including agriculture. They are not national occupational basic pay. The source's occupational code version is unconfirmed, so no canonical PSOC mapping is asserted.
OWS records with inconsistent sampling intervals are withheld; CV above 10% carries a low-precision caution. Missing precision is disclosed, not inferred.
O*NET 31.0 is retrieved and hash-verified, but no O*NET-derived value is published because no accepted PSOC-to-O*NET correspondence exists.

Experimental generative-AI task exposure scores are published for 447 PSOC unit groups, scored task by task from PSA's own PSOC task statements by deepseek-v4.1-flash with at least two successful attempts per task. 3,318 of 3,362 PSA task statements met the minimum; the remaining 44 are excluded because they did not yield two parseable answers. No score is imputed for them and their unit groups carry a partial-coverage flag. Scoring ran at temperature 0, so repeated attempts reproduce the same answer by construction; the attempt-agreement statistic is a reproducibility check, not a stability estimate. Human review status: not_reviewed. The 0–5 ordinal scale is one model's judgement, not a calibrated probability: a different model scored a shared sample systematically higher, and that shift is reported rather than rescaled away. Unit groups without a PSA task list have no score. Scores describe potential task interaction with generative AI, not employment outcomes.
The v1 exposure scores are not carried forward and are not a fallback.
This experimental exposure score has not yet undergone independent labour-economist validation.
No component of this release has been reviewed by a Philippine labour statistician.
